targetTest: it keeps every recurrence key, id and admin status when only the start time changes
expected: After UpdatePublishedEvent changes start_time 10:00 -> 11:00, key 2026-11-06 stays cancelled with starts_at 2026-11-06 11:00:00 UTC and every id/key is unchanged
actual: starts_at stayed 2026-11-06 10:00:00 (UpdatePublishedEvent scaffold is a no-op): Failed asserting that two strings are identical.
semanticAssessment: Target executed and failed on the planned assertion (starts_at not moved to 11:00Z) because UpdatePublishedEvent is a behaviour-free scaffold returning the event unchanged. All 18 failures are assertion failures for missing behaviour: no update/sync/lock/admin check/rollback in the action, EditEvent neither hydrates Repeats from the rule nor delegates the save, the relation manager has no columns, EventsTable lacks the Repeats column and edit action, the command is a no-op and no schedule entry exists. No load, syntax or fixture faults. The 3 passing tests (identical save changes nothing, no delete action on the edit page, no create/edit/delete actions on the occurrences table) are negative guards that a no-op scaffold satisfies by construction; they become meaningful once GREEN adds behaviour.
